# `flow_index_tr`

Persist a confined workspace transport inventory without materializing source files.

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/flow-index-tr.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/flow-index-tr.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter       | Type       | Required         | Description                                                                                                    |
| --------------- | ---------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`       | `string`   | no               | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                                                                   |
| `client`        | `string`   | no               | SAP client number                                                                                              |
| `username`      | `string`   | no               | Username for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `password`      | `string`   | no               | Password for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `systemId`      | `string`   | no               | Logical system id (resolved via the server multi-system configuration)                                         |
| `transports`    | `string[]` | yes              | Items: 1–∞.                                                                                                    |
| `workspaceRoot` | `string`   | yes              | Absolute target directory within a server-owned root Length: 1–∞.                                              |
| `destination`   | `string`   | destination mode | Required when the server runs in destination mode; an ADT destination key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]\{1,62\}$`. |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

**Annotations**

- `readOnlyHint`: `false`
- `destructiveHint`: `false`
- `idempotentHint`: `true`
- `openWorldHint`: `true`

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is JSON (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.
